artifact_contract.refresh: Invalidate the affected lane view when its source or contract changes; publish only at its verified lane head
artifact_contract.validation: Bind project/lane/head/contract/hash/scope; enforce semantic agreement for equivalent views only
artifact_contract.toolchain: Shared installations selected by operation; no mandatory tools.json per lane

formats.value_reader_limitations: Formula expressions and formatting not extracted; source bytes retained.
formats.cell_edit_fidelity: Exact existing cells; active protection, merged/validated/formula ranges, rich text and extended cell metadata refused; unchanged package members preserved.
formats.generated_numbers: At most 15 significant decimal digits within Excel normal range; output values independently reparsed and compared.
formats.generated_dates: ISO dates and timezone-free times through milliseconds; submillisecond requests refused.
formats.recalculation: Separate new Calc-written version; package formatting/objects may change.
formats.render_equivalence: Calc page output is not Microsoft Excel equivalence proof.
